statement: Borrow an element on edit and release it on sync without taking whole workset ownership.
superiority: Merge compatible edits to the same element at parameter level, not element lock.

statement: Avoid conflicting edits by letting only one user borrow an element at a time, routing editing requests to its owner, and marking an element outdated once another user publishes changes so it cannot be edited until the latest changes are loaded.
superiority: Resolve conflicts with a three-way merge view.

acceptance.sketch: A conflicting edit is rejected with a message naming the owner.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Revit prevents conflicts through exclusive borrowing and outdated-element blocking rather than detecting and resolving concurrent changes afterward.

statement: Let an administrator move or rename a file-based central model and let team members point their synchronize dialog at the new central location, warning that users unaware of the move cannot submit changes.

acceptance.sketch: Path resolves for a second user.

statement: Detect possible central-file corruption after each synchronize and let an administrator repair the central model from a local copy, after which everyone creates fresh local copies; an audit option on open scans and fixes corrupt elements.

superiority: Self-healing sync with continuous integrity checks.

acceptance.sketch: Audit completes and file opens.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: Compacting is a sync option, not part of recovery; repair is for file-based central models only.

statement: Flag elements that other users have updated or deleted in the central model with a dedicated display mode and optional colors so users can see what changed since their last synchronization.

notes: CORRECTED 2026-11-14: No page found describing a conflict dialog for deleted-while-editing; the documented behaviour is the Model Updates display mode (plus outdated-element blocking).

statement: In cloud worksharing, project administrators invite members and set project permissions that determine who can access the model, while element ownership and borrowing still govern who can edit what.

statement: Reduce sync time through incremental save and background compaction.
